model_annotation: This chart is a nested donut (ring) chart consisting of two concentric rings that represent two related metrics: "Ambiguity Std" on the outer ring and "Max Ambiguity" on the inner ring. The outer ring contains four slices corresponding to different standard deviation values: "Std: 0.0" shown in the darkest navy/dark teal color at 47.7%, "Std: 0.47" in a medium dark teal at 7.0%, "Std: 0.82" in a medium blue at 5.0%, and "Std: 0.94" in a bright cyan/sky blue at 49.0%, with the slices appearing to be arranged clockwise. The inner ring contains three slices representing maximum ambiguity levels: "Max: 1" in a medium cyan at 14.2%, "Max: 2" in a lighter cyan at 39.0%, and "Max: 3" in the lightest pale cyan at 38.0%, with an additional segment of approximately 8.8% that appears to correspond to the darker teal shade. Percentage labels are displayed directly on or adjacent to each slice in bold text. Two separate legends are provided on the right side of the chart, one for each ring, clearly distinguishing the outer "Ambiguity Std" categories from the inner "Max Ambiguity" categories. The color scheme progresses from dark to light shades of blue and cyan, with darker tones representing lower standard deviation or ambiguity values and lighter tones representing higher values. No slices appear to be visually exploded or offset from the rings.
